logline: 전과자 형은 동생의 논에서 도둑을 잡으려 밤을 새운다.
destination: 응고개 논둑의 소나무 — 도둑을 잡아야 하는 긴박한 순간
anchor: Gaunt man with wild hair and tattered clothes
palette: Cold blue twilight, wet earth tones, dim firelight flickering in shadows.

beats.beat: 농사꾼이 남의 닭을 안고 산그늘로 숨어든다.
beats.visual: a lean farmer clutching a hen under his arm slipping into pine shade below a hill grave mound
beats.motion: he ducks into the shade, the hen flaps once under his arm, pine branches sway

beats.beat: 산에서 내려오며 대장장이 성팔의 의심을 느낀다.
beats.visual: Man descends slope, avoiding eye contact with a blacksmith watching him.
beats.motion: Moving down the hill toward the village

beats.beat: 주막에서 막걸리를 마시고 동생 집으로 향한다.
beats.visual: Man drinks from a clay cup, then walks past a dark, sickly house.
beats.motion: Walking past the sick wife's house

beats.beat: 밤 산길에서 화투 소리를 듣고 재성에게 돈을 준다.
beats.visual: Man hands coins to a crying man emerging from a rocky cave.
beats.motion: Handing money to the other man

beats.beat: 서낭당 뒤에서 논둑의 희끄무레한 형상을 발견한다.
beats.visual: Man peers from a shrine, spotting a blurred figure in the paddy field.
beats.motion: Leaning out from the shrine toward the field

beats.visual: Man waits rigidly against a pine tree, listening to wind and rain.
beats.motion: Standing still against the tree trunk

beats.visual: a pale bundled figure rising from a moonlit paddy bank, a farmer tensed behind a pine
beats.motion: the figure straightens up with the bundle, the farmer leans forward, moonlight shifts

beats.visual: an empty paddy bank path under a lone pine at first light, mist over the stubble field
beats.motion: dawn light spreads along the bank, mist thins over the stubble, the pine stirs

withheld: 도둑은 동생 응오였다는 사실과, 형이 동생을 때렸다는 사실
